Sword & Shield series · PGO

Pokémon GO

Released July 1, 2022 · 88 cards

StandardExpanded

Pokémon GO is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on July 1, 2022. Its main set has 78 cards, plus 10 secret rares numbered beyond the set (88 in total). It includes 74 Pokémon, 14 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

55 illustrators worked on Pokémon GO. Most cards: N-DESIGN Inc. (10), PLANETA Tsuji (4), sadaji (4), Ayaka Yoshida (3), Misa Tsutsui (3), PLANETA Mochizuki (3), Anesaki Dynamic (2), KIYOTAKA OSHIYAMA (2).
